_source: Hand-curated pre-World-Cup (June 2026) Transfermarkt market values, EUR. Approximate ballparks for the board-relevant players, same curation approach as destination/data/target_players_2026.json and worldcup/data/tm_squad_values.json.
_why: The pooled model value V0 leans on a 2022 MV snapshot (median-filled for young players not in the 2022 Big-5), so it understates the pre-WC value of exactly the young risers this feature is about. Where a curated 2026 MV exists it overrides the model value as the jump baseline V0, making the euro amounts realistic; players without an entry fall back to the model value (disclosed).
